title: Answer a data-subject access request
summary: Record the personal-data request, identify the applicable privacy regime and deadline, verify identity proportionately, locate relevant records and review exemptions. Deliver the authorized response securely; where deletion is requested, apply the relevant exceptions, complete the required actions and retain the response record.

parts.title: Log the request and verify the applicable response deadline and extension requirements

execution.rationale: Record the received request and counsel-confirmed statutory clock with its evidence in the case worksheet.

geoResolutions.label: Where CCPA applies, use its response period and notice requirements
Under GDPR, respond within one month or notify a permitted extension within that month

parts.title: Verify the requester's identity proportionately — enough to stop impersonation, never a data grab of its own

execution.rationale: The privacy owner verifies the requester through the existing secure digital relationship, collecting only proportionate evidence and retaining the identity decision.

parts.title: Inventory where this person's data lives: product DB, analytics, support desk, email tools, payment processor

execution.rationale: The privacy owner and system administrators identify the person's records across the actual databases and services, reviewing identity matches and inventory completeness.

parts.title: Assemble the export and draft the response: what you hold, purposes, recipients, retention, sources

execution.rationale: The privacy team gathers and reviews the digital export, redactions and response with the responsible owners, preserving the requester's identity and disclosure checks.

parts.title: Review the exemptions with privacy counsel where it's close: third-party data, privilege, trade secrets

execution.rationale: Privacy counsel reviews the digital request and proposed disclosure for exemptions and records the permitted response.

parts.title: Deliver the authorized response securely by the applicable deadline and retain delivery evidence

execution.rationale: The privacy owner delivers the approved response through a verified secure digital channel and records access controls, delivery and any required extension notice.

geoResolutions.label: Deliver the CCPA response or a permitted extension notice within the applicable period
Deliver the GDPR response or the required extension notice within the applicable period

parts.title: Fix the intake: a records-of-processing map and a standing DSAR runbook so the next one is routine

execution.rationale: Draft the processing map and repeatable request-handling runbook from the reviewed case and actual system responsibilities.

parts.title: Complete requested deletion where required, apply the applicable exceptions and record what was deleted or retained

execution.rationale: Authorized system owners carry out the approved erasure or de-identification in the actual digital systems and record retained exceptions and results.

geoResolutions.label: Apply CCPA deletion requirements and exceptions where they govern the request
Apply GDPR erasure requirements and Article 17 exceptions where they govern the request

links.when: The request seeks access: a copy of the data and the processing details (a request to know).
The request is, or includes, deletion: a GDPR Art. 17 erasure request or a CCPA request to delete.

metadata.trigger: Someone exercises their data rights: a GDPR subject access request or CCPA request to know/delete lands in any inbox.
metadata.supportReason: The data inventory and the export assembly are agent work across your own systems; identity verification judgment, the exemptions review, and the decision to send are human, counsel's where it's close.

geoNotes.summary: UK GDPR's subject access request runs on the same one-month clock with the same two-month extension — the ICO's right-of-access guidance is the canonical employer-side playbook, including the identity-check and exemptions reality.
The PDPA's access and correction obligations are the DSAR analog: respond to access requests under the Act's standards and exceptions, with the PDPC as the regulator disputes route to.

The PDPO's data access request is the DSAR analog: a data user must comply within 40 days of receiving the request (Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance section 19), with the Privacy Commissioner as the disputes route.

contextNeeded.query: the request itself and the date it was received (the clock runs from receipt)
where personal data lives: your systems and processors

countryViews.title: Answer a data-subject access request in United States
countryViews.summary: Identify which US privacy law covers the request. For CCPA-covered requests, the California Attorney General’s guidance gives a 45-day response period. Verify identity, assess exemptions and complete the required access or deletion response under the applicable rules.

countryViews.title: Answer a UK GDPR subject access request
countryViews.summary: Under GDPR, respond without undue delay and within one month of receipt. Complex or numerous requests may allow a two-month extension with notice within the first month (law rule eu.gdpr-dsar-response-deadline). Verify identity proportionately, assess exemptions and securely deliver the response or complete any applicable erasure.
